one_line: A skilled bead and textile craftsman from Arikamedu on the Coromandel coast during the height of Indo–Roman and Bay of Bengal trade.

appearance.age_look: Early 20s, lean and wiry from manual craftwork, with slightly calloused hands and a straight, balanced posture.
appearance.face: Oval face with medium-brown Dravidian complexion, straight nose, strong jaw, soft but focused dark-brown eyes; a few faint bead-dust freckles on the cheeks; default expression is calm concentration with a hint of quiet pride.
appearance.hair: Thick, straight black hair tied into a short, neat low bun at the back of the head; a thin cloth headband in deep indigo wraps around the forehead to keep sweat and stray hair away from the eyes, knotted at the back with small tails.
appearance.costume: A knee-length, unstitched cotton upper cloth (angavastra) in off-white, wrapped around the torso and over the left shoulder leaving both shoulders covered, paired with a tightly wrapped cotton veshti/dhoti in muted terracotta red reaching to the ankles and secured at the waist with a narrow woven belt; the fabric is plain-weave with subtle narrow cream and dark-brown stripes near the hem, indicating local Coromandel weaving; simple leather sandals; minimal jewellery limited to a single thin copper bangle on the right wrist and small rounded ear studs, reflecting artisan status; a small cloth pouch in faded indigo is tied at the belt, hinting at tools and beads within.
appearance.signature: A rectangular, low wooden bead-working tray held in his hands, containing a neat grid of small semi-precious stone beads, a tiny hand bow-drill with a stone drill bit, and a shallow clay dish of fine sand, all dusted with a faint sheen of bead powder.

ref_desc: A lean, medium-brown young man with an oval face, straight black hair in a low bun with an indigo headband, wearing an off-white upper cloth and terracotta dhoti with striped hems, copper bangle and sandals, carrying a wooden bead-working tray with bow-drill and beads in off-white, terracotta, indigo and dark brown tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a lean, medium-brown young male Arikamedu artisan: oval face, calm focused dark-brown eyes, straight black hair tied in a short low bun with a simple indigo cloth headband knotted at the back; he wears a knee-length off-white cotton upper cloth wrapped around his torso and over the left shoulder, fully covering his chest, and a tightly wrapped ankle-length cotton dhoti/veshti in muted terracotta red with subtle cream and dark-brown woven stripes near the hem, secured at the waist with a narrow woven belt and paired with plain leather sandals; add a single thin copper bangle on his right wrist, small rounded ear studs, and a small faded indigo cloth pouch tied at his belt; in his hands he carries a rectangular low wooden bead-working tray containing rows of tiny semi-precious stone beads, a small hand bow-drill with a stone drill bit, and a shallow clay dish of fine sand, with faint bead dust on the tray; use an earthy palette of off-white, terracotta red, indigo, dark brown and copper, and show him from multiple angles so the face, low bun with headband, wrapped garments, sandals and bead-working tray are all clearly visible and consistent.
